profiles.ch06:
jaffle_dbt:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: duckdb
      path: ../practice/practice.duckdb   # relative: ALWAYS run dbt from the jaffle_dbt folder
      schema: dbt_adnane
      threads: 4
    prod:
      type: duckdb
      path: ../practice/practice.duckdb
      schema: prod
      threads: 4
profiles.ch10:
jaffle_dbt:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: duckdb
      # DBT_DUCKDB_PATH lets CI (or a test) point to another file; the default is our practice database
      path: "{{ env_var('DBT_DUCKDB_PATH', '../practice/practice.duckdb') }}"   # relative: run dbt from jaffle_dbt
      schema: dbt_adnane
      threads: 4
    prod:
      type: duckdb
      path: "{{ env_var('DBT_DUCKDB_PATH', '../practice/practice.duckdb') }}"
      schema: prod
      threads: 4
profiles.ch24:
jaffle_dbt:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: duckdb
      # DBT_DUCKDB_PATH lets CI (or a test) point to another file; the default is our practice database
      path: "{{ env_var('DBT_DUCKDB_PATH', '../practice/practice.duckdb') }}"   # relative: run dbt from jaffle_dbt
      schema: dbt_adnane
      threads: 4
    ci:
      # an EMPTY schema used to check a change in isolation (Chapters 24-25)
      type: duckdb
      path: "{{ env_var('DBT_DUCKDB_PATH', '../practice/practice.duckdb') }}"
      schema: dbt_ci
      threads: 4
    prod:
      type: duckdb
      path: "{{ env_var('DBT_DUCKDB_PATH', '../practice/practice.duckdb') }}"
      schema: prod
      threads: 4
